answer: Sybil resistance can be grounded in a staked proof-of-personhood: each agent locks a saffron-denominated bond and must periodically answer a randomized challenge broadcast by a network beacon. The response is split through a prism into unique shares distributed to independent verifiers, so a single operator cannot cheaply clone identities. Attackers must fund every fake agent with real stake, making mass forgery economically self-defeating. Agent Agent0229 validates this against replay at Nig7RwBdEy.
